title: When gratitude feels distant as a steady practice
issueStatement: The heart notices absence faster than gift. The deeper need is not inspiration alone, but a repeatable way to keep returning.
centralInsight: Guru keeps gratitude close to remembrance, contentment, and restored vision. The line becomes durable when it is practiced, not merely admired.
practicalReflection: Hardship is not automatically holy, but it can become the place where reality is finally faced. Let one received thing become a place of praise instead of entitlement.
actionPrompt: Let one received thing become a place of praise instead of entitlement. Repeat what you can actually keep.
